articles.headline: Nexalin Technology Taps Neuromodulation Commercial Executive Robert DiTota to Advise on its Global Commercialization Strategy
articles.summary: Nexalin announces Robert DiTota's appointment as senior strategic advisor for global commercialization. The September 29 publication is distinguished from the stated September 15 effective appointment date.
articles.timestampEvidence: Original GlobeNewswire header explicitly gives September 29, 2026 09:00 ET. Exact elapsed age qualifies only for the first October 1 entry.

articles.author: Nexalin Technology, Inc.
articles.headline: Nexalin Technology Signs Definitive Exclusive Distribution and Local Manufacturing Agreement for Brazil and South America
articles.summary: Nexalin announces a ten-year distribution framework with Inovanexa across seven South American countries, including an initial binding ten-device order. The 100-device pricing framework and future royalty/local-manufacturing plans do not guarantee further purchases, fulfilled orders or recognized revenue.
articles.timestampEvidence: Original distributor header explicitly gives October 1, 2026 08:30 ET.
